title: Savills APAC Research Publication
description: Single record in /data/publications.json. The array of these records is the canonical source of truth for the publication calendar.

id.description: UUID or slug. Stable unique identifier; generated client-side on add.

country.description: One of the 14 markets (Global Research treated as a country-like option).

city_state.description: Free-text city or state/region within the market. May equal the country for city-states.

lead_author.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-06-18). The named individual who owns/authors the publication, distinct from the broader team. UI tolerates null/missing.

start_date.description: OPTIONAL in JSON, REQUIRED in the master sheet for recurring rows (added 2026-06-18). For recurring series: the ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the series begins. Future instances are projected on/after this date. Null = project from the upload/build date. Backend-only: not surfaced in the detail panel.

recurring_timing_window.description: OPTIONAL (added 2026-06-18, v4). For recurring rows whose exact date is not yet known: the within-month timing band used to estimate a placeholder date (Early month -> 5th, Mid-month -> 15th, Late month -> 25th, each snapped to a business day). 'TBD' or null falls back to the last business day of the month.

date_confidence.description: Per-instance confidence in the publication date (added 2026-06-18, v4). Owner-set value in the master sheet overrides platform inference; if blank the platform infers it: a confirmed Expected Publication Date -> 'Confirmed' (next occurrence only); a timing window or fallback estimate -> 'Estimated'; no date and no timing -> 'TBD'. Shown in the detail panel.

report_scope.description: Regional reports are the default landing view. In-Country reports are local-market only.

status.description: FUTURE-EXTENSIBLE. NOT required in v1. UI tolerates null/missing. Planned future values: idea, drafting, review, sign off, published, delayed.
